suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require Parkinson disease diagnosis before the depressive-disorder onset for this proposition; exclude/segregate depression predating PD and consider prodromal/bidirectional timing. Population follow-up supports post-diagnosis temporal risk only; no causal/aggravation pathwayIntelligence. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
